AmerisourceBergen
(now rebranded as Cencora) is
a major global pharmaceutical distributor and healthcare solutions provider
, not a manufacturer of consumer-facing continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or sleep trackers. Its focus is on supply chain management, clinical trial logistics
, and provider solutions, rather than personal remote patient monitoring hardware.
AmerisourceBergen
Overview of Consumer Health Tech vs. Distribution
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like the FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom measure interstitial glucose, distributed via companies like AmerisourceBergen to pharmacies and hospitals.
SEC.gov
Smartwatches & Wearables:
Brands like Apple, Samsung, and Fitbit offer onboard fitness, sleep tracking, and wearable ECG.
Wareable
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Clinical setups utilizing connected health feeds, managed via healthcare providers rather than wholesale pharmaceutical distributors.
